thread:
maria_ux: hitting a weird one in the sampleapp — rerank step failing intermittently. sometimes embedding dims are 1536 instead of 1024 and reranker crashes. anyone seen this?

sam_devex: can you paste the request/response or a log? sounds like either model mismatch or batching bug.

maria_ux: here's the relevant call (node sampleapp):
```js
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1024', input: texts });
// then we chunk into batches of 16 and send to /rerank
```
log: `Error: invalid vector dims: expected 1024 got 1536`

chris_backend: are you sure the client is hitting the right model? 1536 is common for the new 'open-embed-1536' family. maybe routing/fallback changed?

maria_ux: I log the model name we pass: open-embed-1024. also this only happens when we batch 2+ docs together — single-doc calls always 1024.

ola_sdk: quick suspicion: Node SDK added an automatic multiencode path that sometimes switches model param when `input` is an array vs string. Python SDK didn't have that.

sam_devex: ohhh SDK parity issue + batching edge. can you repro consistently?

maria_ux: repro ~30% when batch size >=8. here's the raw response snippet (sanitized):
```json
{
  "data": [
    {"embedding": [0.001, ...], "model": "open-embed-1024"},
    {"embedding": [0.002, ...], "model": "open-embed-1536"}
  ]
}
```
Notice model shows 1536 for some items.

ben_support: seeing mixed-models in one response is definitely a server-side smell but could be the SDK concatenating replies from two backend shards. we should audit the streaming/merge code.

sam_devex: concrete checklist: 1) reproduce with verbose logs (include response.model per item), 2) confirm whether server ever returns mixed dims in a single request, 3) add defensive DX helpers in SDK/sampleapp to validate dims before sending to reranker.

chris_backend: i'll instrument the inference gateway to log model assignment per request id for the next 12h and look for mixed-model merges. tag me if you get a repro id.

maria_ux: repro id: r-20260312-9a7b (posted to logs). also noticed that when the auth token refresh happens mid-batch we occasionally resend the batch partially which might cause merge of two responses — one old, one new.

ola_sdk: that ties into the retry/auth flow I've been poking at. current behavior: on 401 we refresh token and reissue the last HTTP POST — but the client-level batching code doesn't dedupe, so if the original request completed on server but client got a 401 mid-stream we can end up merging partial payloads.

sam_devex: two parallel fixes then: server should avoid mixing model variants in one response; SDK should add a small helper to validate and normalize embedding arrays before downstream rerank. also we should add idempotency per batch to prevent double-apply.

maria_ux: for immediate mitigation on the sampleapp I pushed a local helper: `normalizeEmbeddings` — it checks dims and either trims/pads or errors with a clear message. snippet: 
```js
function normalizeEmbeddings(items, expectedDim = 1024){
  return items.map(v => {
    if(v.length === expectedDim) return v;
    if(v.length > expectedDim) return v.slice(0, expectedDim);
    // pad with zeros (cheap heuristic)
    return v.concat(new Array(expectedDim - v.length).fill(0));
  });
}
```
This unblocks the demo but obviously not ideal for production.

ben_support: also recommend adding `Idempotency-Key` header per batch with a UUID. that helps the server detect duplicate batched submissions when tokens are refreshed.

ola_sdk: on parity notes — discovered another minor format mismatch: Node SDK returns `data[i].embedding` while Python returns `data[i].embeddings` (plural) in earlier patch. that's going to confuse naive sampleapps. opened PR #3456 to unify to `embedding` singular across SDKs.

sam_devex: good catch. we'll standardize field name in the SDKs and draft a migration note in the sampleapp README.

chris_backend: server-side: i've flagged the gateway team. initial findings: we do occasionally stitch shards when a request spans multiple workers; there was no guard to ensure consistent `model` routing for shards. adding a check so shards for the same request pick compatible variants only. will push a hotfix behind a feature flag.

maria_ux: thanks — timeline? demo next Tuesday so need a short-term plan.

chris_backend: hotfix behind flag in ~4h, monitor for 24h. if stable we'll roll to prod.

ola_sdk: i'll land the SDK parity PR today and also add `validateEmbeddings(items, expectedDim)` to the Node SDK helpers so sampleapps can call it.

sam_devex: open issue for sampleapp changes + add integration test that asserts all embeddings in a batch have same .length and .model. I'll take that.

ben_support: I'll update the support KB with guidance: if you see `invalid vector dims` — enable `DEBUG=sampleapp` logs, check model names per-embedding, and apply padding only as a last resort.

maria_ux: sweet. one more UX ask: could we add a clearer error code on the rerank API (400.2) like `inconsistent_embedding_dims` so users don't have to parse stack traces?

sam_devex: yes, adding error codes is low friction. filing PR for API error codes and sampleapp README note.

devex-bot: incident-note created: #INC-2026-03-12-embed-dim-mismatch, assigned: chris_backend, ola_sdk, sam_devex, severity: medium.

maria_ux: :thumbsup: thanks all — will update demo branch once helpers + idempotency are in.

ola_sdk: assigning tasks: PRs -> #3456 (parity field), #3457 (node helper validateEmbeddings), #3458 (idempotency header docs).

sam_devex: i'll add the integration test and the API error-code PR. keeping this thread updated with repro logs.

chris_backend: i'll post gateway logs here once the hotfix runs.

maria_ux: closing loop: after fixes landed i will run the full demo runbook and post results.
